in_sanskrit.name: Kannu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kannu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Kannu is the name of the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. She is also known as Saraswati or Saraswati Devi. The name Kannu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Knowledge'.
